title: CNN's Betsy Klein, MS NOW and Politico Reporters Denied White House Entry as Trump Ban Takes Effect
detail: President Trump's ban on CNN, MS NOW and Politico took effect Saturday morning, September 19, 2026, when reporters from all three outlets arrived at the White House and were turned away. CNN senior White House reporter Betsy Klein said her press pass had been deactivated and a Secret Service agent would not explain why; MS NOW correspondent Akayla Gardner described having her badge disabled at the scanning gate, and a Politico reporter and an MS NOW photographer were also denied access. CNN said it would continue 'to hold the government and other public bodies to account,' while MS NOW said 'the White House belongs to the American people' and pledged to defend its First Amendment rights. Media analyst Brian Stelter called the ban 'a direct threat to press freedom in the United States.' All three outlets signaled they would pursue legal action, which they filed two days later.

media.caption: CNN's Betsy Klein and MS NOW's Akayla Gardner reported live after their White House press credentials were deactivated the morning Trump's ban took effect
